name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width, lower it to mid-chest under control, then press back to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: On a bench set to 30-45 degrees, lower the bar to the upper chest and press it back up over the shoulders.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: With feet secured on a decline bench, lower the bar to the lower chest and press it back to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat holding a dumbbell over each shoulder, lower them to chest level with elbows at about 45 degrees, then press up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: On an incline bench, lower the dumbbells to the sides of the upper chest and press them back together overhead.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lying flat with a slight bend in the elbows, open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch, then bring the dumbbells back together.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Standing between two high pulleys, sweep the handles down and together in front of the hips, then return slowly.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with mid-chest, press forward to near lockout, and return under control.

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Sit tall with arms on the pads or handles and bring them together in front of the chest, then open slowly.

name: Push-Up
instructions: From a straight-arm plank, lower the chest to just above the floor keeping the body in one line, then press back up.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: On parallel bars, lean the torso forward and lower until the shoulders are just below the elbows, then press back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: With the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it, brace, and stand up by driving through the floor, keeping the bar close. Lower it the same way.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes turned out, grip inside the knees, and stand up by pushing the knees out and the hips forward.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: From standing, push the hips back with a soft knee bend and lower the bar along the legs until the hamstrings are stretched, then drive the hips forward.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar, grip the handles, brace, and stand up tall, then lower under control.

name: Rack Pull
instructions: Set the bar on pins at about knee height and pull it to lockout, squeezing the glutes and upper back at the top.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back and row the bar to the lower ribs, then lower it until the arms are straight.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: With the torso near parallel to the floor, row the bar explosively from a dead stop on the floor to the lower chest, and return it to the floor each rep.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: With one hand and knee on a bench, row the dumbbell toward the hip, then lower it to a full stretch.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the bar, hinge forward, and row the handle to the chest, keeping the back flat.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sitting tall with a slight knee bend, pull the handle to the stomach while squeezing the shoulder blades together, then extend the arms.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip the bar wider than the shoulders and pull it to the upper chest while leaning back slightly, then let it rise under control.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Using a close neutral-grip handle, pull to the upper chest keeping the elbows close to the body.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower to a full hang.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang with an underhand, shoulder-width grip and pull the chin over the bar, then lower fully.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Hanging under a bar with heels on the floor and body straight, pull the chest to the bar and lower.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With arms nearly straight, sweep the bar from eye level down to the thighs using the lats, then return slowly.

name: Face Pull
instructions: With a rope at face height, pull toward the forehead while flaring the elbows and rotating the hands back.

name: Back Extension
instructions: On a hyperextension bench, lower the torso by hinging at the hips, then raise it back to a straight line.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Holding the bar at arm's length, lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears, pause, and lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: With a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, shrug the shoulders straight up, pause, and lower.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Standing with the bar at the collarbone, brace and press it overhead to lockout, moving the head back and then through.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated with back support, press the dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead, then lower.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with palms facing you at the chin and rotate them outward while pressing overhead; reverse on the way down.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height and press overhead, then return under control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Standing side-on to a low pulley, raise the handle out to shoulder height with the far arm, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height, then lower them under control.

name: Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinged forward with a flat back, raise the dumbbells out to the sides leading with the elbows, then lower.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Holding the bar with a shoulder-width grip, pull it up along the body to chest height with elbows high, then lower.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until it touches the chest, then return slowly.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Standing with elbows at your sides, curl the bar to the shoulders without swinging, then lower fully.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells up while turning the palms to face the shoulders, then lower under control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: With palms facing each other, curl the dumbbells to the shoulders and lower slowly.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: With the upper arms on the preacher pad, curl the bar up and lower it to nearly straight arms.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Facing a low pulley, curl the bar to the shoulders keeping the elbows fixed, then lower.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Seated on an incline bench with arms hanging behind the torso, curl the dumbbells up and lower to a full stretch.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Seated with the elbow braced against the inner thigh, curl the dumbbell to the shoulder and lower slowly.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: With elbows pinned at your sides, push the bar or rope down until the arms are straight, then let it rise to about 90 degrees.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then extend.

name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lying flat, lower the bar toward the forehead by bending only at the elbows, then extend back up.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Bench press with hands about shoulder-width apart and elbows tucked, touching the lower chest.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: With hands on a bench behind you and legs extended, lower the hips by bending the elbows, then press back up.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms resting on the thighs with palms up, curl the weight up using only the wrists, then lower.

name: Back Squat
instructions: With the bar on the upper back, brace and sit down between the hips to at least parallel, then drive back up.

name: Front Squat
instructions: With the bar across the front of the shoulders and elbows high, squat down keeping the torso upright, then stand.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Holding a kettlebell at the chest, squat down between the knees keeping the chest up, then stand.

name: Leg Press
instructions: With feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower it until the knees reach about 90 degrees, then press without locking the knees.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: With shoulders under the pads, squat down to at least parallel and drive back up through the whole foot.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: With the rear foot on a bench, lower until the front thigh is about parallel, then drive up through the front foot.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then drive through the front foot into the next step.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto a box with one foot and stand up fully using that leg, then step back down.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Seated with the pad above the ankles, extend the knees until the legs are straight, then lower slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lying face down with the pad behind the ankles, curl the heels toward the glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Seated with the pad behind the lower legs, curl the heels under the seat, then return under control.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: With the upper back on a bench and the bar over the hips, drive the hips up until the torso is level, squeeze, and lower.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, drive the hips up until knees, hips and shoulders line up, then lower.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Squat down with the chest up until the thighs are at least parallel, then stand back up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: With the balls of the feet on the edge, rise as high as possible onto the toes, pause, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Seated with the pad on the knees, raise the heels as high as possible, then lower to a full stretch.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Seated with the pads inside the knees, squeeze the legs together, then open under control.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Seated with the pads outside the knees, push the legs apart, then return slowly.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height, letting it fall back into the next rep.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels on the forearms and toes, bracing the abs. Log the hold as a duration.

name: Side Plank
instructions: On one forearm with feet stacked, lift the hips into a straight line and hold. Log the hold as a duration.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lying on your back with knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor toward the pelvis, then lower.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hanging from a bar, raise the legs to at least hip height without swinging, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneeling below a high pulley with the rope at your head, crunch the ribs toward the hips, then return.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneeling with the wheel under the shoulders, roll forward as far as you can control with a flat back, then pull back.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated leaning back with feet up, rotate the torso side to side. Each side counts as one rep.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Log the run as a duration and/or distance.

name: Outdoor Run
instructions: Log the run as a duration and/or distance.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Log the ride as a duration and/or distance.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Drive with the legs, then lean back and pull the handle to the ribs. Log as a duration and/or distance.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Log the session as a duration and/or distance.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Log the climb as a duration.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Log as a duration, or as reps for a counted set.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop into a squat, kick back to a plank, return to the squat, and jump up. One full cycle is one rep.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: From a deep lunge, drop the inside elbow toward the front foot, then rotate that arm to the ceiling. Log each side as reps.

name: Hip 90/90
instructions: Seated with both knees bent at 90 degrees, rotate the legs from side to side keeping the chest tall.

name: Cat-Cow
instructions: On hands and knees, alternate between rounding the spine up and letting it sag down, moving with the breath.

name: Barbell Triceps Extension
steps: Position barbell overhead with narrow overhand grip.
Lower forearm behind upper arm with elbows remaining overhead. Extend forearm overhead. Lower and repeat.

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Row
steps: The same as regular rowing, but holding a reversed grip (your palms pointing forwards):

Grab the barbell with a wide grIp (slightly more than shoulder wide) and lean forward. Your upper body is not quite parallel to the floor, but forms a slight angle. The chest's out during the whole exercise.
Pull now the barbell with a fast movement towards your belly button, not further up. Go slowly down to the initial position. Don't swing with your body and keep your arms next to your body.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Put the balls of your feet on an extended leg press pad. Use your calves to press the weight by flexing your feet/toes into a pointed position, and releasing back into a relaxed position.
This exercise builds mass and strength in the Gastrocnemius and Soleus muscles as well, if not better, than any calf exercise.

name: Incline Crunch
steps: Lay down on your back on a inclined bench, feet are on one end of the bench. Ask a partner or use some other help (barbell, etc.) to keep them fixed, your hands are behind your head. From this position move your upper body up till your head or elbows touch your knees. Do this movement by rolling up your back.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
steps: Take a cable in your hands (palms parallel, point to each other), the body is straight. Bend the arms and bring the weight up with a fast movement. Without any pause bring it back down with a slow, controlled movement, but don't stretch completely your arms.
Don't swing your body during the exercise, the biceps should do all the work here. The elbows are at your side and don't move.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lay down on a bench and hold onto the recliner with your hands to keep you stable. Hold your legs straight and lift them till they make an angle of about 45°. Make a short pause of 1 sec. and go slowly down to the initial position. To increase the intensity you can make a longer pause of 7 sec. every 5th time.

name: EZ-Bar Military Press
steps: On an SZ-bar grip your hands on the outside of each bend and stand with your arms straight down, palms facing your legs. Pull the bar (bending your arms at the elbow) to your chest, and the push the bar above your head (arms as straight as possible). Return the bar to your chest by dropping your arms at the elbows. Return the bar to it's origional position (stand with your arms straight down, palm

name: Decline Crunch
steps: Sit yourself on the decline bench and fix your legs. Cross your arms over the chest and bring with a rolling movement your upper body up, go now without a pause and with a slow movement down again. Don't let your head move during the exercise.

name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, toes pointed forward, and chest tall.
Extend your leg straight out; extend both arms in front of you, at shoulder level. Brace your core and look straight ahead.
Slowly squat down.
(optional) pause at the bottom.

name: Push Press
steps: Clean your dumbbells onto your shoulders, palms facing in. Take a breath and brace your core. (picture 1)Dip at the knees and use your legs to help (picture 2) press your dumbbells overhead. Lower under control with a slow tempo to your shoulders and repeat.

name: Side Crunch
steps: Hold weight in one hand. Bend side ways to the knee. Pull upo to upright position using your obliquus.

name: Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Grab the cable, stand with your feet shoulder wide, keep your back straight and lean forward a little. Push the bar down, making sure the elbows don't move during the exercise. Rotate your hands outwards at the very end and go back to the initial position without pause.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your body. Keep your palms towards your body. Lift you hands straight up until your hands are under your chin, then lower them. Repeat the exercise.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Adjust the weight and the pulleys to the right height. You should be able to see the pulleys because they should be above your head.
With your right hand, grab the left pulley, and with your left hand, grab the right pulley, crossing them in front of you. This is where you’ll begin your journey.
Start the movement by moving your arms back and forth while keeping your arms straight.
Pause at the finish of the move for a brief moment before returning the handles to their starting positions.

name: Incline Bench Reverse Fly
steps: The incline dumbbell reverse fly is an upper-body exercise targeting the posterior or rear deltoids, as well as the postural muscles of the upper back. Because it targets such small muscles, this exercise is usually performed with light weight for high reps, such as 10-15 reps per set or more.

name: Suspension Biceps Curl
steps: Grab the handles of the TRX straps, lean your body back, arms and legs extended, with your body positioned in a single straight line. (This is an arm exercise, not an abdominal one.)

name: Suspension Row
steps: This exercise serves as a lead-up to Pull Ups.

name: Kettlebell Curl
steps: Standing with the kettlebell in one hand and bent at the elbow, start from a fully extended position until your hand reaches shoulder height. To perform the movement correctly, try not to push with your back or body.

name: High knees
steps: Run in place, putting knees as high up as is comfortable and switching legs at a quick pace.

name: Reverse Lunge
steps: Step backward with one leg so it can bend comfortably to a 90 degree angle.
Slowly bend both knees to form 90 degree angles.
Return to the starting position.
Repeat, alternating legs.

name: Floor Dip
steps: Raise your hips off the ground, straightening your arms.
Bend your elbows, bringing your hips down.
Straighten your arms, returning to the previous position.
Repeat steps 2 and 3.

name: Hindu Push-Up
steps: Exercise to strengthen the shoulders and pectorals. Its name is due to the fact that it begins in the Yoga position "Dog Facing Down", passing to "Cobra" but without resting the legs or torso on the ground to finally end with a normal flexion. The exercise can also be performed backwards (back to the starting position). As a variation, after doing the push-up, the hip can be raised to return to do

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
steps: Grab your dumbbells and lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground (use a bench if you have one). Press the weights up, locking out your elbows (A). Lower them slowly until your upper arms are resting on the floor (B) close to your body. Pause here before explosively pressing back up. Squeeze your chest hard and repeat.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Drop into a strong plank position, bringing your hands close together until they're almost touching. (picture 1)Bend your elbows to slowly bring your chest to the floor (picture 2). Keep your elbows close to your body as you push back up explosively. Repeat. Ensure you take your time lowering on each rep, keeping your form sharp.

name: Dumbbell Hang Power Clean
steps: On your feet, stand tall with your dumbbells, holding them at your sides. Hinge at the hips to lower them to your knees (picture 1). Stand back up with a slight jump, using the momentum to pull the dumbbells up on to your shoulders (picture 2). Stand up straight, then lower under control to your sides and repeat. Keep this fast and explosive; if your heart rate doesn’t hit the roof, you’re doing t

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Lower your dumbbell to the ground between your legs. Assume a wide stance and with a straight back squat down. With the dumbbell standing upright, grip it by the top of the ‘head’ (picture 1).Keeping your chest up and core braced, push the floor away, driving back upwards to a standing position (picture 2). Repeat. If you can easily achieve 20-30 reps, use two dumbbells.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
steps: In the correct plank position, place your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. alternately lift and touch the opposite shoulder with one hand.

name: Seated Rear Delt Raise
steps: Seated, bent 45 deg forward. Arms fully stretched out, raise arms up to shoulder height and back down

name: Wall Ball
steps: Get a medicine ball, shoulder width stance, squat, thrust the ball as high as possible against the wall and catch

name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on floor or mat. Place arms slightly behind you. Raise legs. Now extend your legs and pull them back.

name: Cable Concentration Curl
steps: The concentration curl is a classic exercise for building the biceps one arm at a time. It can be performed bent over or kneeling, but is more often performed seated on a bench. It's great for emphasizing the biceps peak and is often used to finish a biceps workout

name: Close-Grip Supinated Lat Pulldown
steps: Downward movement • Pull the bar down so that it passes close to your chin and touches the upper part of your chest. • Keep the rest of your body still.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: This exercise lets you work the upper, or larger, part of the glutes. For that reason, it should never be missing from your routine of isolated exercises for training the glutes. Stand in front of a cable machine and locate the low pulley. Then attach the ankle strap to work on the low pulley. As for your posture, you should stay upright at all times. Pay special attention to your back to keep it

name: Neutral-Grip Chest Pulldown
steps: Position yourself in front of the cable machine with your knees slightly bent and your feet on the floor.
Grip the cable handle with your palms facing each other and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the handle down until it touches or comes close to your chest, holding the position for one or two seconds.
Slowly raise the handle back to the starting position, making sure to keep your arms and hands straight and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Cable Pullover
steps: Keeping your back fixed and your abdominal muscles contracted, inhale and bring the bar down to your thighs while keeping your arms extended (or your elbows slightly bent). Exhale at the end of the movement.

name: Incline Bench Pulldown
steps: Lying face down on the incline bench facing the cable machine, perform the pulldown.

name: Fingertip Push-Up
steps: Hand Positioning:
Start in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Spread your fingers wide apart, placing them firmly on the ground.
Finger Placement:
Gradually lift your palms off the ground, shifting the weight onto your fingers.
Focus on distributing the load evenly across your fingertips and thumbs.
Body Alignment:
Maintain a straight line from head to heels to engage your core.
Keep your body in a controlled and stable position throughout the exercise.
Lowering Phase:
Slowly bend your elbows, lowering your chest towards the ground.
Ensure controlled movement, maintaining stability on your fingertips.

name: Wide-Grip Dumbbell Curl
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and palms facing forward. Bend your elbows and lift the dumbbells to your shoulders. Slowly return and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Curl to Press
steps: Bend your elbows and lift the dumbbells to your shoulders. Push the dumbbells over your head while rotating your arms to make your palms face forward. Reverse it to lower down. Repeat the exercise.

name: Standing Biceps Stretch
steps: Stand with your left arm close to a wall. Extend your left arm and put your left hand on the wall, then gently turn your body to the right.

name: Standing Calf Stretch
steps: This stretch targets the gastrocnemius (the chief muscle of the calf of the leg, which flexes the knee and foot). It is easy to perform anywhere. All you need is a wall or a chair.

name: Incline Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
steps: Set up an adjustable bench at a 45-degree angle. Lay on your stomach with your head hanging just above the edge of the bench. Grab a dumbbell in each hand and set up with a good posture – core and lats engaged and shoulders neutral. Row the dumbbells toward the top of the stomach and squeeze the back at the top of the rep. Finally, lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat until

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing down) approximately shoulder-width apart. Ensure your back is straight, shoulders slightly pulled back, and arms fully extended. Curl the barbell upwards towards your chest in a controlled motion, keeping your elbows close to your body. The motion should be smooth without any swinging or momentum use. Once the barbell is at chest level, pause br

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: The low-cable cross-over is an isolation movement that uses a cable stack to target the upper portion of the pectoral muscles. It is common in upper-body and chest-focused muscle-building workouts, often in combination with presses or flyes from other angles to target all portions of the chest.

name: Cable Cross Triceps Extension
steps: The high-cable cross tricep extension is an isolation exercise for targeting the triceps, particularly the long head. It utilizes cables and handles grasped with opposite hands, allowing for a unique pressing motion that can be effective for building tricep strength. Unlike exercises that use a straight bar or rope, this variation can be more comfortable on your wrists and elbows

name: Dumbbell Hex Press
steps: Engage the muscles
Position your feet wide
Controlled movement
Slow movement
Bring the weights toward your lower chest/stomach

name: Torso Twist
steps: Standing Torso Twist WorkoutTarget your core and improve flexibility with this dynamic standing exercise! The Standing Torso Twist Workout involves twisting your torso while keeping your feet and hips stable, engaging your obliques, and stretching your entire upper body. This movement helps to:Strengthen core musclesIncrease flexibility in the spine and torsoImprove posture and balanceEnhance over

name: Good Morning
steps: Stand with your feet more than shoulder-width apart (wider stance) and place your hands on your hips. Hinge at your hips and lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight then come back up.

name: Seated W Curl
steps: Sit on bench with 60° incline
Hold dumbbells beside body near the ground, palms facing outwards, arms fully extended
Move dumbbells up using only biceps and without momentum

name: Knee to Chest Stretch
steps: The knee to chest stretch is a simple yet effective exercise for relieving lower back tension and improving hip mobility. To perform, lie flat on your back with your legs extended. Bring one knee toward your chest, wrapping your hands around your shin or behind your thigh. Gently pull the knee closer to your chest while keeping the other leg straight on the floor. Hold the stretch for 15–30 second

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: The "Smith Machine Split Squat" is a strength exercise performed on the Smith machine, ideal for targeting the legs and glutes. It involves placing one foot forward and the other back, lowering the body until the front thigh is parallel to the ground while the bar slides vertically along the machine. This exercise helps improve stability, correct muscle imbalances, and reduces stress on the back,

name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest in goblet position. Place one foot on a slider, gliding disc, or towel. Keep your chest tall and core engaged. Slowly slide the foot outward to the side while bending the opposite knee, lowering your hips into a lateral lunge. Keep the working leg’s knee aligned with the toes and avoid letting it collapse inward

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Place your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, pointing your toes outward. Keep your back straight, shoulders back, and chest up. The knees must follow the same direction as the toes and not move forward. When going up, it is advisable to contract your glutes to maximize the effectiveness of the exercise..

name: Band Glute Kickback
steps: A rubber band glute kickback is an exercise performed on hands and knees, where you anchor a resistance band to your foot and kick your heel back and up, squeezing your glute at the top of the movement, while maintaining a stable core and flat back to target and strengthen the gluteal muscles.

name: Dumbbell Donkey Kick
steps: The dumbbell donkey kick is an effective exercise for working the glute and hamstring muscles. This exercise is usually performed on all fours, using a dumbbell to add resistance. The steps for performing it correctly are described below. Starting position: Get on all fours on a mat, with your hands aligned under your shoulders and your knees aligned under your hips. Placing the dumbbell: Take a d

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
steps: The seated dumbbell calf raise is a targeted exercise for strengthening the lower leg muscles. It follows the same movement pattern as the machine version: you place the weight on your knees, and by extending and flexing your ankles, you move the weight.

name: Unilateral Cable Row
steps: Put a vertical seated bench in front of the cable row machine.position it so that you can focus on one side, and then do slow pulls focusing on the lateral muscles and ensuring tention in those muscles when in a stretched position.

name: Rope Pullover
steps: Set up bench in front of cable row machine. Lean over bench to do a row/pullover with rope that targets lats. See picture.

name: Dumbbell Bent Over Face Pull
steps: This exercise involves using dumbbells to perform a bent over face pull, which targets the upper back and shoulders. The movement involves pulling the weights towards the face while keeping the elbows high and squeezing the shoulder blades together.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
steps: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height and performing a squat. It targets the lower body muscles, including the quads, hamstrings, and glutes, while also engaging the core and upper body.

name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
steps: This exercise involves holding a kettlebell in one hand and standing on one leg while bending forward to touch the kettlebell to the ground. It targets the hamstrings, glutes, and lower back while also improving balance and stability.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: This exercise involves sitting on the ground with a dumbbell resting on the hips, then thrusting the hips upward while squeezing the glutes. It is a great exercise for strengthening the glutes and improving hip mobility.

name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lay down
(Optional) Bend your knees to add difficulty
(Optional) Bend your knees and let your feet rest on a bench or a box or something (90 degree angle on knees)
Lift your head and torso while bending your back forward (if you don't it's a sit-up and also involves some back muscles). The higher you go, the more you should feel your abs contracting.
Go back to starting position an repeat

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in one hand and bending sideways to work the oblique muscles on the side of the body. It can be done standing or seated and is often used as a core strengthening exercise.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
steps: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in each hand and stepping back into a lunge position, then returning to standing. It primarily targets the glutes, hamstrings, and quadriceps.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in each hand and bending forward at the hips while keeping the back straight, then returning to a standing position. It primarily targets the hamstrings and glutes.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Squat
steps: This exercise involves holding a dumbbell in one hand and performing a squat while stepping to the side. It targets the legs, glutes, and core muscles.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: The machine lateral raise is an isolation exercise that targets the medial (side) deltoid muscle to build wider, more defined shoulders. The machine's fixed path of motion provides greater stability than dumbbells, making it ideal for beginners or those who want to focus solely on muscle activation.

name: Band Face Pull
steps: Face pulls with band – standing horizontal pull. Grab the band at face height, pull elbows high and wide towards your face while squeezing shoulder blades together. Trains upper back, rear shoulders and improves posture.

name: Cable Front Raise
steps: The Cable Front Raise with a small bar isolates your anterior deltoids (front shoulders) by providing constant tension, requiring you to stand facing away from a low pulley, grab the bar with an overhand grip, and lift it in front of you to shoulder height with slightly bent arms, avoiding swinging and keeping your core tight for controlled movement up and down. Use a light-to-moderate weight, foc
How to Perform the Cable Front Raise (Bar)
Setup: Attach a small straight bar to a low cable pulley. Set the weight to a light or moderate setting.

Starting Position: Stand with your back to the machine, holding the bar with an overhand grip (palms facing down) at hip level, arms extended but not locked. Feet shoulder-width apart, core braced, shoulders back and down.
The Lift: Exhale and slowly raise the bar straight up in front of you, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until your hands reach shoulder height (or slightly below).
The Hold: Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your front delts.
The Lower: Inhale as you slowly and controllably lower the bar back to the starting position, maintaining tension.

name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: Technique and Execution
The Smith machine squat is a variation of the traditional barbell squat that uses a guided, fixed-path barbell. Here's a detailed breakdown of the proper technique:
Starting Position
Foot Placement: Position feet slightly forward of the bar, about shoulder-width apart
Bar Position: Rest the bar on your upper trapezius/shoulders, similar to a traditional back squat
Stance: Feet can be slightly angled outward for natural hip rotation
Squat Movement
Unrack the bar by rotating it to release from the safety hooks
Slowly lower your body by bending knees and hips
Descend until thighs are parallel to the ground (or slightly below)
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position

name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rocks
steps: Move your knee forward, keeping your heel on the ground. Hold the position for a couple of seconds and return to the starting position.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell on your upper back. Step 2: Keep your back straight, chest up, and core engaged. Step 3: Take a step back with one leg and lower your body by bending both knees. Ensure that your back knee nearly touches the ground. name: Machine Decline Chest Press
steps: Sit upright in a hammerstrength decline chest press machine while squeezing your shoulder blades together and placing your heels firmly on the ground underneath your knees.
The back pad should be contact with your head, shoulders, and butt at all times.
Grab ahold of the handles with an overhand grip just outside shoulder-width apart just below your chest.
Keeping your core braced by breathing into your stomach and flexing the abdominal muscles, push through your palms to extend your elbows while keeping them at a 45 degree angle from your torso.
Once your arms are fully extended, return to the starting position.

name: Decline Bench Leg Raise
steps: Setup : Lie on a decline bench with your head at the top and grip the handles.
The Start : Extend legs fully, keeping them slightly elevated to engage your core.
The Lift : Raise your legs toward the ceiling using your abs, not momentum.
The Squeeze : Pause and contract your lower abdominals at the top.
The Return : Lower your legs slowly to the starting position with control.

name: Tuck planche
steps: Basic calisthenics progression for the full planche

name: Seated Cable Chest Fly
steps: Place a bench between two cable pulleys and adjust the pulleys so they are at chest/shoulder height when you are seated.
Grab the handles with a neutral grip and lean against the upright backrest.
Bring your arms together in front of your chest in a controlled motion, focusing on squeezing your chest muscles. Keep your elbows slightly bent throughout the movement.
Pause briefly at the top position.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position while maintaining control of the movement.
Repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Snatch
steps: Key Steps to Execute Correctly:
Setup: Place the dumbbell between your feet, with your shoulders above your hips, chest up, and back flat.
The Pull: Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles (triple extension) to drive the dumbbell upward, keeping your elbow high and the dumbbell close to your body.
The Catch: Quickly flex your hips and knees to drop under the dumbbell and receive it overhead with your arm locked in position, landing in a half-squat stance.

Common Mistakes: Using your arms too much to lift the weight instead of your legs, having a low elbow during the pull phase, and misaligning your shoulder, elbow, and wrist in the final position. For beginners, it’s recommended to start with light loads, focus on technique, and perform 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 5 reps per arm.

name: Mentzer Pulldown
steps: Close grip front facing Pull down, while focusing on Biceps, Increases activation of biceps over the whole range, Avoid activating Lats.

name: Band Terminal Knee Extension
steps: This is an end range strengthening exercise for the knee extensors. Start by looping a band around the back of one knee and anchoring the other end to a stable surface in front of you. Stand in a split stance with the banded knee bent and placed as the front leg. name: Stomach Vacuum
steps: Starting position : Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor (or stand/sit upright).
Exhalation : Fully exhale all the air from your lungs through your mouth.
Contraction : Draw your navel in towards your spine as far as possible, pulling your stomach inward and up under your ribcage.
Hold : Hold this isometric contraction without breathing for 10 to 20 seconds.
Release : Slowly inhale through your nose to release the tension and relax your abdominals.
Repeat : Rest briefly and perform the desired number of sets.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand a foot from a sturdy box. Dip, swing the arms and jump up, landing softly with both feet flat on the box. Step down - don't jump down.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Squat to parallel, then drive up and leave the floor. Land softly through the whole foot and go straight into the next rep.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and walk tall with short, quick steps. Shoulders down, ribs down, don't let the weights swing. One step is one rep.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: From a high plank, drive one knee to the chest, then switch legs quickly. Keep the hips level with the shoulders. Each knee drive is one rep.

name: Skater Jump
instructions: Leap sideways from one foot, land on the other and let the trailing leg swing behind. Stick the landing, then bound back. Each landing is one rep.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
instructions: Lift the ball overhead on your toes, then slam it into the floor in front of you as hard as you can, hinging at the hips. Catch it on the bounce and repeat.

name: Lateral Lunge
instructions: Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight and both feet flat. Push back to standing. Alternate sides.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: On hands and toes with the knees an inch off the floor, crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot together. Keep the back flat. One step is one rep.

name: Inchworm
instructions: From standing, fold forward and walk the hands out to a plank, then walk the feet in toward the hands with straight legs. Stand up and repeat.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up and knees over hips. Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly toward the floor while pressing the lower back flat, then switch.
